verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the implementation-relevant expectation that accessing ProjectRebuild must not display a malicious-site warning.
First concrete failure: the client reports that the malicious-site warning appears when accessing ProjectRebuild.
The client records the false-positive report and adds the developer-verification submission as a concrete trust-warning remediation step; no prior attributes become obsolete.
Target-specific implementation claim: the immediately preceding request unambiguously identifies the developer project-verification submission the freelancer says was completed.
